title.zh: 阿布拉省节庆纪念日（Arya Abra）
title.orig: An Act Declaring March Nine of Every Year a Nonworking Public Holiday in the Province of Abra, to Be Known as "Arya Abra Day"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7682_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Philippine Legislature enacted on March 9,1917 Act No. 2683, which segregated Abra from Ilocos Sur and gave it full provincial status.
March nine of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking public holiday in the Province of Abra, to be known as"AryaAbraDay."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, February 23, 1994.
